oauthError.fallbackBody: SassyAuth couldn't process the authorization request.
oauthError.fallbackHint: Contact a platform administrator with the URL you tried to load.

invalid_request.heading: Authorization request rejected
invalid_request.body: The request is missing PKCE parameters or used an unsupported challenge method.
invalid_request.hint: The client must send code_challenge and code_challenge_method=S256.

APP_NOT_FOUND.heading: Application not found
APP_NOT_FOUND.body: The requesting application isn't registered with SassyAuth.
APP_NOT_FOUND.hint: Verify the client_id (a Sqid) matches a row in the Apps list.

invalid_redirect_uri.heading: Redirect URL doesn't match
invalid_redirect_uri.body: The redirect URL the application sent doesn't match the URL registered for it.
invalid_redirect_uri.hint: Open Apps, find this row, and update URL so its origin matches the redirect endpoint.

USER_NOT_FOUND.heading: Account not provisioned
USER_NOT_FOUND.body: Your sign-in succeeded, but no SassyAuth account is linked to it.
USER_NOT_FOUND.hint: Ask a platform admin to create a SassyAuth user record for your email and assign you to an org.

USER_ORG_MISMATCH.heading: Not authorized for this application
USER_ORG_MISMATCH.body: Your account is provisioned in SassyAuth but isn't scoped to the application you tried to access.
USER_ORG_MISMATCH.hint: Ask a platform admin to add you to an org associated with this application.

social_no_account.heading: We couldn't sign you in
social_no_account.body: That account isn't set up for this application.
social_no_account.hint: If you were invited, sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to, or ask an administrator to invite you.

social_email_unverified.heading: Email address not verified
social_email_unverified.body: Your identity provider did not confirm that this email address belongs to you.
social_email_unverified.hint: Verify the address with your provider, then try again.

social_private_relay.heading: Hidden email addresses aren't supported
social_private_relay.body: You chose Apple's Hide My Email, so we received a relay address that doesn't match any invitation.
social_private_relay.hint: Sign in with Apple again and choose "Share My Email".
